notes: The report says the target of 50% senior leaders from high-growth markets was discontinued for the 2030 strategy. The goal of being a leading employer for inclusion was not met by 2025 and has been restated for 2030. Inclusion figures are inconsistent across the report (74% status, 88% inclusion index, 82% engagement score). Some activities are pilots (rose GAP programme for about 60 producers; women's leadership coaching), so they were not treated as company-wide. The FEI start-up support also serves Givaudan's own innovation. Small and local customers (59% of sales to local and regional customers) count only as serving. The ongoing competition-authority investigation into the fragrance industry is not a rights finding. Ooby and the AI creation tools are internal creative inputs and were not scored above 1.
